fact: A World Bank mission of 8-12 September 2025 records that INIC and DGRN want to avoid over-dependence on external consultants, and that the project aims to have INIC, rather than costly foreign consultants, run the work and maintain the systems, with a consultant contract moving from co-development to troubleshooting.
title: Ajuda Memória: Missão de Apoio a Implementação para o Projecto Digital São Tomé e Príncipe
